visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a white quilted vest over a black-and-white striped shirt, walks and talks directly to the camera. The setting is an outdoor city street during the day under overcast lighting, with gray buildings and a yellow vehicle partially visible in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a hand with vibrant pink-magenta nail polish resting on a soft pink pillow featuring a cartoon rabbit graphic. (3) A white knitting instruction binder is opened on a white table. Hands flip through the pages, which contain detailed black-and-white diagrams and Japanese text instructions for knitting patterns. (4) A close-up shot displays a collection of knitting tools inside a light-colored canvas and black case, including red-handled crochet hooks and wooden needles. (5) The woman is shown indoors, sitting at a desk and carefully knitting with pink yarn. She is focused, and the background features organized shelves filled with clear bins of colorful yarn. (6) A low-angle shot captures green tree branches and palm trees swaying against a bright sky with heavy white clouds and sunlight filtering through. (7) Returning to the indoor setting, the woman smiles broadly at the camera while holding up a small piece of purple lace-knitted fabric she has completed. (8) A close-up shows a golden-brown cabbage omelet sizzling in a black frying pan with visible bubbles of cooking oil. (9) The finished omelet is served on a white plate; a silver knife and fork cut into the fluffy egg, revealing shredded cabbage inside.
